svg.title: BURIED • TIME BOMB CHECKPOINT
svg.desc: Original Dead Drop written reference diagram. Tell your teammates before rewinding.
svg.text: Throw/place the bomb to save the checkpoint.
Finish the specific task that requires the rewind.
Use its detonator to return to the saved state.
Maxis: save before first wisp arrival; rewind after it.
Richtofen: bomb on Guillotine; all four players nearby.
Progress exceptions are task-specific; follow the linked route.
Original reference diagram • not an in-game screenshot
